1.label: very_easy
1.summary: One tug requires planar XZ tracking, with one look-alike and a 2.4-second forecast.
1.natural_language: Link each tug portrait to its matching camera subject. Fit its 3D cuboid using both camera plates and the sparse scan. Start the live survey, then keep every cuboid centered, sized and oriented on its moving tug until the simultaneous-fit bar fills. The active scan lasts at most 90 seconds. Calibration links and volume edits are reversible. Start commits the camera links; wrong links end the episode. Brief tracking slips remain correctable, and each lost-track bar refills when its tug is fitted again. Ten continuous seconds lost, unfinished scan expiry, or incomplete certification ends the episode. Certify is a final submission, including before Start. A later reset or submission cannot undo a failed episode. The motion trail and dotted forecast labelled on the camera are visible guidance; boxes never automatically follow a toy. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in this task webpage.
